AboutPageContent.title: About Us
AboutPageContent.paragraph1: Ever Peak Adventure is a leading Nepal-based adventure travel company dedicated to delivering authentic, safe, and unforgettable Himalayan experiences. Established by a team of passionate mountaineers and experienced travel professionals, our company was founded with a clear vision—to share the true spirit of the Himalayas through responsible, well-organized, and meaningful adventures.
AboutPageContent.paragraph2: We specialize in trekking, hiking, peak climbing, mountaineering, and cultural tours across Nepal's most breathtaking and diverse landscapes. Fully licensed by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of Nepal, and proud members of the Trekking Agencies Association of Nepal (TAAN) and the Nepal Mountaineering Association (NMA), Ever Peak Adventure operates with the highest standards of professionalism, safety, and ethical responsibility.
AboutPageContent.paragraph3: We strictly follow government regulations and international safety guidelines to ensure every journey is conducted with care, transparency, and respect for both travelers and local communities. With more than a decade of hands-on experience, our expert guides, climbing leaders, and support team have successfully guided travelers from around the world through iconic regions such as Everest, Annapurna, Langtang, Manaslu, and beyond.
AboutPageContent.paragraph4: Our guides are highly trained, knowledgeable, and deeply familiar with the terrain, culture, and challenges of high-altitude travel, ensuring both safety and enriching experiences throughout. At Ever Peak Adventure, we believe that travel is more than just reaching a destination—it is about meaningful connections, cultural discovery, and personal achievement. From world-famous trekking routes to hidden valleys and culturally rich destinations, every journey we design is carefully customized to match your interests, schedule, fitness level, and sense of adventure.
AboutPageContent.cultureText: Driven by passion, integrity, and respect, we foster a safety-first, team-oriented culture that values authentic experiences, responsible tourism, and genuine care for every traveler and community we serve.
AboutPageContent.missionText: To deliver safe, authentic, and enriching Himalayan adventure experiences while promoting responsible tourism, cultural respect, and environmental sustainability, ensuring every journey creates meaningful memories and positive impact for travelers and local communities alike.
AboutPageContent.visionText: To become a globally trusted adventure travel company recognized for excellence, integrity, and innovation showcasing Nepal as a premier destination for trekking, mountaineering, and cultural exploration while preserving its natural beauty and heritage for future generations.
AboutPageContent.goalsText: To design and operate high-quality, personalized adventure journeys that inspire confidence, challenge limits, and foster genuine connections while upholding the highest standards of safety, professionalism, and ethical responsibility in the Himalayas.

DirectorMessageContent.contentHtml:
Message From Managing Director

Welcome to Ever Peak Adventures. When we founded this company, our goal was simple yet profound: to share the raw majesty of the Himalayas while ensuring absolute safety, deep cultural respect, and sustainable tourism.

Nepal is not just a destination; it is a living sanctuary of mountains, ancient traditions, and warm-hearted communities. Every trek we design is crafted to give you a genuine, life-changing connection with this incredible landscape.

Whether you are stepping onto the glaciers of Everest Base Camp or exploring the green valleys of Annapurna, our dedicated team of local experts is with you every step of the way.

FAQ.question: How long is the Manaslu Circuit Trek?
FAQ.answer: The Manaslu Circuit Trek typically takes between 14 to 18 days depending on your exact itinerary, side trips, and acclimatization schedule.

FAQ.question: How difficult is the Manaslu Circuit Trek?
FAQ.answer: It is considered a challenging trek involving high mountain passes like Larkya La (5,106m), requiring good physical fitness and prior high-altitude hiking experience.

FAQ.question: Do I need prior trekking experience?
FAQ.answer: Yes, previous high-altitude trekking experience is highly recommended due to remote terrain and strenuous daily elevation gains.

FAQ.question: What is the best time to trek the Manaslu Circuit?
FAQ.answer: The best seasons are Autumn (September to November) and Spring (March to May) offering stable weather and crystal-clear mountain views.

FAQ.question: Do I need a special permit?
FAQ.answer: Yes, Manaslu is a restricted area requiring a Special Restricted Area Permit, TIMS, and ACAP/MCAP permits handled through a registered agency.

FAQ.question: Can I trek solo in Manaslu?
FAQ.answer: No, solo trekking is strictly prohibited in the Manaslu region. You must be accompanied by a licensed guide and have at least two trekkers in your group.

FAQ.question: What is the highest point of the trek?
FAQ.answer: The highest point is the breathtaking Larkya La Pass standing at an elevation of 5,106 meters (16,752 feet).

FAQ.question: Will I get altitude sickness?
FAQ.answer: Altitude sickness can affect anyone. Proper acclimatization, staying hydrated, and ascending gradually significantly lower the risks.

FAQ.question: What happens in case of emergency?
FAQ.answer: Our expert guides carry comprehensive medical kits, oximeters, and maintain direct satellite/cellular communication with our Kathmandu headquarters for immediate rescue evacuation if required.

FAQ.question: What type of accommodation is available?
FAQ.answer: Accommodations consist of cozy local teahouses and lodges offering twin-sharing rooms with basic amenities and warm hospitality.

ResponsibleTravelContent.contentHtml:
Our Commitment to Sustainable Tourism

At Ever Peak Adventures, we believe that traveling through the majestic Himalayas comes with a profound responsibility to protect the environment, respect local cultures, and support indigenous mountain communities.

We actively practice Leave No Trace principles, minimize plastic waste on our trails, and ensure fair working conditions, proper insurance, and safety equipment for all our local guides and porters.

By booking with us, you directly contribute to community development, education initiatives, and environmental preservation in the remote regions we visit.

TermsPageContent.contentHtml:
Booking & Payment Conditions

Please read these terms and conditions carefully before booking any trek, tour, or climbing expedition with Ever Peak Adventures. By booking a trip with us, you accept these terms in full.

1. Deposits and Payments

To secure a booking, a non-refundable deposit of 20% of the total trip cost is required upon confirmation. The remaining balance can be paid upon arrival in Kathmandu prior to departure.

2. Cancellations and Refunds

If you need to cancel your trip, notice must be given in writing. Cancellation fees apply depending on how close to the departure date notice is received. We strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance covering trip cancellation.

3. Health and Fitness

Clients must disclose any medical conditions or physical limitations at the time of booking. Our itineraries involve high-altitude trekking where medical facilities can be remote.
